# Resource: tfe_test_variable

Creates, updates and destroys environment variables used for testing in the Private Module Registry.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.organization.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.oauthClient.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.registryModule.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.testVariable.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        Organization tfeOrganizationTestOrg = new Organization(this, "test_org", new OrganizationConfig()
                .email("admin@company.com")
                .name("my-org-name")
                );
        OauthClient tfeOauthClientTestClient = new OauthClient(this, "test_client", new OauthClientConfig()
                .apiUrl("https://api.github.com")
                .httpUrl("https://github.com")
                .oauthToken("my-token-123")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTestOrg.getName()))
                .serviceProvider("github")
                );
        RegistryModule tfeRegistryModuleTestModule = new RegistryModule(this, "test_module", new RegistryModuleConfig()
                .organization("test-module")
                .testConfig(List.of(new RegistryModuleTestConfig()
                        .testsEnabled(true)
                        ))
                .vcsRepo(new RegistryModuleVcsRepo()
                        .branch("main")
                        .displayIdentifier("GH_NAME/REPO_NAME")
                        .identifier("GH_NAME/REPO_NAME")
                        .oauthTokenId(Token.asString(tfeOauthClientTestClient.getOauthTokenId()))
                        .tags(false)
                        )
                );
        new TestVariable(this, "tf_test_test_variable", new TestVariableConfig()
                .category("env")
                .description("some description")
                .key("key_test")
                .moduleName(Token.asString(tfeRegistryModuleTestModule.getName()))
                .moduleProvider(Token.asString(tfeRegistryModuleTestModule.getModuleProvider()))
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTestOrg.getName()))
                .value("value_test")
                );
    }
}
```

```terraform
# Usage of the write-only value for tfe_test_variable

variable "session_token" {
  description = "The session token for use in the write only field"
}

resource "tfe_organization" "test_org" {
  name  = "my-org-name"
  email = "admin@company.com"
}

resource "tfe_oauth_client" "test_client" {
  organization     = tfe_organization.test_org.name
  api_url          = "https://api.github.com"
  http_url         = "https://github.com"
  oauth_token      = "my-token-123"
  service_provider = "github"
}

resource "tfe_registry_module" "test_module" {
  organization = "test-module"
  vcs_repo {
    display_identifier = "GH_NAME/REPO_NAME"
    identifier         = "GH_NAME/REPO_NAME"
    oauth_token_id     = tfe_oauth_client.test_client.oauth_token_id
    branch             = "main"
    tags               = false
  }
  test_config {
    tests_enabled = true
  }
}

resource "tfe_test_variable" "tf_test_test_variable" {
  key              = "key_test"
  value_wo         = var.session_token
  value_wo_version = 1
  description      = "some description"
  category         = "env"
  organization     = tfe_organization.test_org.name
  module_name      = tfe_registry_module.test_module.name
  module_provider  = tfe_registry_module.test_module.module_provider
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Whether this is a Terraform or environment variable. Valid values are `"terraform"` or `"env"`.
- `key` (String) Name of the variable.
- `moduleName` (String) The name of the registry module on which this test variable is set.
- `moduleProvider` (String) The provider of the registry module on which this test variable is set.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization that owns the registry module on which this test variable is set.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Description of the variable. Defaults to `""`
- `hcl` (Boolean) Whether to evaluate the value of the variable as a string of HCL code. Has no effect for environment variables. Defaults to `false`.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value is sensitive. If true then the variable is written once and not visible thereafter. Defaults to `false`.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the variable. Defaults to `""`. Cannot be used with `valueWo`.
- `valueWo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Value of the variable in write-only mode. Cannot be used with `value`.
- `valueWoVersion` (Number) Version identifier for the write-only value. Required when `valueWo` is specified to trigger updates. Cannot be used with `value`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the variable.
- `readableValue` (String) A non-sensitive read-only copy of the variable value, which can be viewed or referenced in plan outputs without being redacted. Will only be present if the variable is not sensitive.
